<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services:

- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

Each service has its own `CLAUDE.md` with service-specific commands and pitfalls. Read it before working in that directory.

## Conventions (all services)

- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: branch off `main`, keep branches short-lived, merge quickly. Do not create long-lived branches.

## Incidents

For incident response, use the `incident-runbook` skill rather than improvising steps.

<parameter name="content"># Claude Code context layout for atlas

Principle: always-loaded context (CLAUDE.md) holds only short, broadly relevant facts. Long or occasional material loads on demand (skills). Anything that must never happen is enforced by a hook or permission, not just prose. External systems go through MCP.

## Files and mechanisms

| Location | What goes there | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | Service map, conventional commits, `make check` before PR, trunk-based dev, pointer to the incident skill | Applies to every session in the repo, so it is short enough to always load. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Go/gRPC commands; `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`, never hand-edit | Loads only when working in `api/`; keeps Go details out of web/pipeline sessions. |
| `.claude/rules/api-gen.md` (frontmatter `paths: api/gen/**`) | Reminder: generated, edit the `.proto` and run `make proto` | Surfaces the warning exactly when a generated file is touched, even from another directory. |
| `.claude/settings.json` → `PreToolUse` hook on `Edit`/`Write` matching `api/gen/**` | Blocks the edit with a message pointing to `make proto` | Hand-edits are silently overwritten, so this should be enforced deterministically rather than left to advice. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Use `npm run test:unit`; `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers, so run it only when asked | Per-directory command pitfall; only relevant in `web/`. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Run `export AIRFLOW_HOME=$PWD/.airflow` (from `pipeline/`) before importing or testing DAGs | Per-directory setup step; a CLAUDE.md note keeps the path correct, unlike a repo-wide `env` setting with a relative path. |
| `.claude/skills/incident-runbook/SKILL.md` (+ step files alongside) | The 20-step runbook, with instructions to walk the engineer through one step at a time and confirm before moving on | Long, occasional, and identical across the company: a skill loads only when invoked, instead of bloating every session. Because it is company-wide, publish it from one place (an internal plugin/marketplace) rather than copying it into each repo, so there is a single source of truth. |
| `.mcp.json` (project scope) or an org plugin: warehouse SQL MCP server | Live SQL against the analytics warehouse | Live data access belongs in a tool, not in prose. Use a read-only warehouse role and credentials from the environment, never committed. |
| `.claude/settings.json` → `permissions` | Allow the warehouse MCP query tool for analysts; deny writes and secrets paths; optionally `ask` on `npm test` | Keeps data access scoped and auditable. |
| `.claude/skills/product-metrics/SKILL.md` (optional) | Metric definitions, table names, query conventions for the warehouse | Helps analysts get correct SQL; loads only for metrics questions. |
| Managed / org-level CLAUDE.md (optional) | Org-wide conventions (conventional commits, `make check`) if the company wants them everywhere | The conventions are org-wide, so they can live there. They stay in the root file too, since repo-specific enforcement should work for everyone who clones atlas. Remove the duplication if managed policy is guaranteed. |
| `CLAUDE.local.md` / `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal preferences | Not shared; keeps individual taste out of the repo. |

## Deliberately not in CLAUDE.md

- The 20-step runbook: too long and rarely needed, so it would cost tokens in every session.
- Warehouse access and credentials: needs a tool and permissions, not instructions.
- Generated-code protection as the only safeguard: advice can be ignored, so the hook backs it up.

## Notes

- The incident skill should be user-invocable (`/incident-runbook`) and may also trigger automatically when an engineer describes a live incident.
- Analysts may not work inside the repo; if so, ship the MCP server and metrics skill as the same org plugin rather than via atlas.
- Keep each CLAUDE.md small. If one grows past roughly 100 lines, move the detail into rules or skills.
